Compute hospital-level Charlson and Elixhauser comorbidities

Source: R/comorbidities.R
run_comorbidities.Rd

Diagnoses are scored once per hospital admission. ICU identifiers are an optional projection: admissions without an ICU remain in the output with a missing ICU identifier, while admissions with multiple ICU stays inherit the same hospital-level result on each ICU row.

Usage

run_comorbidities(
  src_name,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  maps = c("charlson", "elixhauser"),
  con = NULL,
  icd_adjudication_path = NULL,
  publish = TRUE,
  enrichment = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (for example, "mimic_iii_demo").

db_name

Optional Postgres database name.

base_dir

Project root. Defaults to getwd().

maps

One or both of "charlson" and "elixhauser".

con

Optional explicit DBI connection.

icd_adjudication_path

Optional reviewed eICU ICD-version crosswalk.

publish

Whether to transactionally publish the result.

enrichment

Optional overrides from enrichment_options() or a named list.

Value

Invisibly returns the comorbidities data frame.

Details

Flag columns record whether any code of the category is present, with ICD-9 and ICD-10 evidence combined. Scores apply the standard hierarchy to those combined flags (comorbidity::score(assign0 = TRUE)): when both the mild and the severe form of a condition are present (for example diabetes with and without complications, mild and severe liver disease, solid tumour and metastatic cancer), only the severe form is weighted.

eICU ICD versions are resolved from exact dictionary evidence and the reviewed adjudication asset. Ambiguous or unmatched codes are excluded from scoring and represented by comorbidity_status; regex suggestions never determine a scoreable version.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run_comorbidities("mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "rendehr", maps = c("charlson", "elixhauser"))
} # }
